crossRefs.note: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to…
God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who…

translations.web: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
translations.bsb: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
translations.kjv: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
translations.asv: Let my lips utter praise; For thou teachest me thy statutes.
